Here's Telford Vice, our correspondent from Durban - "Hello from a cloudy, cooler Durban. The pitch should remain sound for at least the first session."

Mitchell Starc: [On Matt Renshaw's performance] He's having a fantastic week. Hopefully we can top it off for him. But I think amongst all the carry-on, I think he said something he'd never thought he'd get a Test wicket. Yahooing about, 'I've got a Test wicket.' So, it was fantastic. He's having a hell of a week, and I think as Travis Head said, when you're on a heater, you never leave the table.

Starc (2/2): [On the footmarks] Well, obviously they haven't got any left-handers left, so they've only got Ryan at the top there is the only lefty. So I'm not so worried about the other side of the wicket, but yeah, obviously with two left armers in this Test match, I think Marco's got a shorter stride length, but a bigger foot than me, so he's probably started that and I've topped it off. So, there's a little bit of purchase there in those two foot marks there for Matty and Gazza. [On Steve Smith, who was struck on the helmet yesterday] He was a bit obviously a little bit rattled. Well, not rattled, he obviously got the concussion yesterday. This morning it looks like he's got the life back in him, so good signs. I'm not sure what the plan is for him today, but no, he's got a smiling face. I think we've got some golf coming up, so he might be getting ready for that. But no, he looks good today.
